name: Letter to Jin'Zil
summary: At the Crossroads, Letter to Jin'Zil carries word of Serena Bloodfeather's defeat. Darsok Swiftdagger sends it to the Darkspear witch doctor in the Stonetalon Mountains, telling him the northern Barrens are free of the Bloodfeather threat.

sections.title: A Messenger to Stonetalon
sections.body: After the harpies at the Dry Hills are wiped out and Serena Bloodfeather is slain, Darsok Swiftdagger writes to an old comrade. The harpies of the Barrens first roosted in the peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains. Darsok sends news of the fallen matron to Jin'Zil, a witch doctor, and introduces a promising warrior to the wider frontier.

sections.title: Old Memories in Malaka'jin
sections.body: At the cave in Malaka'jin, Jin'Zil receives the news with nostalgic satisfaction. Serena's death recalls the founding of Durotar after the Third War, when Rokhan, Jin'Zil's friend, joined Rexxar, a half-ogre beastmaster, to kill Serena's elder sister, Bloodfeather. Serena has fallen too, and Jin'Zil believes the Bloodfeather line's vengeance is ended.

faq.q: Who wrote the Letter to Jin'Zil?
faq.answer: Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc at the Crossroads in the Barrens, wrote the letter. He coordinates the defense against marauding harpy covens.
Jin'Zil lives in a cave at Malaka'jin, a Darkspear troll outpost in the southeast crags of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What is the news contained in the letter?
faq.answer: The letter tells Jin'Zil that Serena Bloodfeather, leader of the harpies descending into the northern Barrens, has been slain. Her death secures the perimeter north of the Crossroads.

faq.q: Why does Jin'Zil care about the Bloodfeathers?
faq.answer: Jin'Zil remembers the founding of Durotar after the Third War, when his companion Rokhan and Rexxar, a half-ogre warrior, killed Serena's elder sister. Serena sought revenge against the Horde ever since, so her downfall brings a welcome resolution.

angles.text: As a Horde traveler, you carry news from defending the Barrens into the deeper conflicts of the Stonetalon Mountains.
As a troll, you can bring the letter to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil, an elder practitioner who carries on traditional voodoo outside the Echo Isles.
